intent: Promote fast, reliable cloud storage and uptime

options.text: We offer high-speed cloud storage backed by a 99.9% uptime SLA.
options.rationale: Replaced the unsubstantiated 'fastest' claim and swapped the absolute 100% uptime guarantee with the official 99.9% SLA.

options.text: Get high-performance cloud storage backed by a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA.
options.rationale: Used a punchier call-to-action tone while replacing the prohibited superlative and absolute uptime claim with factual SLA terms.

options.text: We deliver ultra-fast cloud storage with an average 180 ms sync latency and a 99.9% uptime SLA.
options.rationale: Incorporated specific internal benchmark latency data to replace 'fastest' and corrected the uptime promise to the 99.9% SLA.
